predecessors.name: Gujarat Sultanate
predecessors.text: Nagaur, where Shams Khan, brother of Muzaffar Shah I, founded the principality

ledger.x: 1405: Shams Khan, brother of Muzaffar Shah I, founds the Nagaur principality (between 1405 and 1407).
c.1535: end year from the task hint; the page itself records only Rana Kumbha's 1455 victory over Shams Khan and the Gujarat sultans, after which Nagaur fell under Mewar.
End of the Khanza dynasty, per the hint; not dated on the page.

certainty.note: Page gives no frontier; years after 1455 rest on the hint.
